title: Identify uniform circular motion as accelerated

hook.scenario: Aap ek giant wheel (ferris wheel) par baithe hain jo bilkul ek hi speed se ghoom raha hai.
hook.question: Agar wheel ki speed badh ya ghat nahi rahi, toh phir bhi us motion ko physics mein 'accelerated' kyun maana jata hai?

mental_model.intuition: Velocity = Speed + Direction. Circular track par direction har second ghumti hai, isliye velocity ghumti hai. Aur jahan velocity ghumti hai, wahan automatically acceleration aa jata hai.
mental_model.description: Acceleration sirf speed ke tej ya dheema hone se nahi aata, balki disha (direction) badalne se bhi aata hai. Gool ghoomti hui cheez ka steering continuously mud raha hota hai, isiliye usme ek constant inward (andar ki taraf) acceleration hota hai.

explanation:
Uniform circular motion ka matlab hai jab ek object gol (circular) path par bilkul constant speed se ghoomta hai. Isme us object ki numerical value (jaise 10 km/h) hamesha fix rehti hai. Normal intuition kehta hai ki agar speed constant hai to acceleration zero hona chahiye. Par physics mein acceleration ka connection speed se nahi, balki 'velocity' se hota hai.

Humne pehle padha tha ki velocity ek vector quantity hai (speed + direction). Jab object ek circle me ghoom raha hota hai, uski disha har single instant par badal rahi hoti hai. Agar ek pathar dhaage me bandh kar ghumate ghumate aap us dhaage ko chhod dein, toh wo seedhi disha (tangent ke along) me aage bhagega. Har point par direction of motion exactly tangent hoti hai us circle ki.

Kyunki disha (direction) lagatar change ho rahi hai, hum kehte hain ki us object ki velocity continuously change ho rahi hai, bhale hi speed same ho. Aur acceleration ka definition hi hai 'rate of change of velocity'. Is logic se, jab velocity change ho rahi hai to acceleration definitely present hai.

Is acceleration ki disha hamesha circle ke center (beech) ki taraf hoti hai, jise hum Centripetal Acceleration kehte hain. Ye ek aisa sawal hai jo board exams (MCQ and reasoning) me har saal kisi na kisi roop me ghoom kar aata hai.

key_points.title: Continuous change in direction
key_points.detail: In circular motion, the direction of motion changes at every single point.

key_points.title: Velocity changes
key_points.detail: Because velocity is a vector, a change in direction means a change in velocity, even if the speed (magnitude) is constant.

key_points.title: Always Accelerated
key_points.detail: Since velocity is continuously changing, uniform circular motion is always an accelerated motion.

worked_example.problem: An artificial satellite is orbiting the earth at a constant speed. Is its motion accelerated?

steps.narration: Satellite circular path par ek constant speed me chal raha hai, to uski disha har pal badal rahi hai.
Disha badalne se velocity badalti hai, jo acceleration paida karti hai.
steps.math: Change in direction → Change in velocity → Acceleration.

worked_example.answer: Yes, it is an accelerated motion due to the continuous change in direction.

prediction.question: Agar direction continuously change ho rahi hai, toh iska matlab velocity change ho rahi hai. Toh kya acceleration maujood hai?
choices: Nahi, speed constant hai toh a=0
Haan, kyunki velocity direction par depend karti hai
prediction.explains: Acceleration = rate of change of velocity. Speed constant hone ke bawajood, direction ke ghoomne se velocity lagatar badalti hai, isliye circular motion hamesha accelerated hota hai.

reflection.prompt: Yeh force/acceleration kis disha mein lagta hai jab body uniformly circle mein ghoomti hai?
reflection.answer: Hamesha center ki taraf (centripetal). Tabhi toh wo object circle mein ruka rehta hai aur straight bhaag nahi jata.

diagram3d.caption: Uniform circular motion is an accelerated motion — force hamesha centre ki taraf point karti hai.

poster.caption: Uniform circular motion is accelerated because direction changes continuously.

worked_example.problem: Why doesn't a body moving with uniform speed in a straight line have acceleration, but the same body moving with uniform speed in a circle does?

steps.narration: Straight line me disha (direction) change nahi hoti.
steps.math: Straight line: Constant speed + Constant direction = Constant velocity (a=0).
Circle: Constant speed + Changing direction = Changing velocity (a ≠ 0).

worked_example.answer: Because in a circle the direction changes continuously, changing the velocity and causing acceleration.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing 'Uniform' with 'Zero Acceleration'
common_mistakes.explanation: Chapter me is se pehle tak 'Uniform velocity' ka matlab zero acceleration tha. Bacche 'Uniform circular motion' padh kar yahan bhi vahi concept laga dete hain, jo ki galat hai.

common_mistakes.title: Focusing only on magnitude
common_mistakes.explanation: Students sochte hain a = (v-u)/t. Since v (speed) and u (speed) barabar hain (5-5=0), to a=0 hoga. Par yahan v aur u ki directions alag hain to unhe seedha minus nahi kar sakte.

recall_questions.q: Is uniform circular motion an accelerated motion?
Why is uniform circular motion considered accelerated despite constant speed?
recall_questions.answer: Because the direction of motion changes continuously, causing a continuous change in velocity.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of speed?

oa_questions.question: What happens to the velocity of an object moving in a circular path with uniform speed?
oa_questions.answer: The velocity changes continuously due to the continuous change in the direction of motion.
oa_questions.approach: Distinguish between speed (magnitude) and velocity (magnitude + direction). Focus on the change in direction.

oa_questions.question: Give one example of a motion where an object does not change its speed but its direction of motion changes continuously.
oa_questions.answer: Uniform circular motion (e.g., an artificial satellite orbiting the Earth or a stone tied to a string being whirled in a circle).
oa_questions.approach: Provide a real-world example of circular motion where the speed is maintained constant.
